# &lt;netinet/tcp.h&gt;

Source: [`src/libc/include/netinet/tcp.h`](https://github.com/lassedtu/ginnOS/blob/main/src/libc/include/netinet/tcp.h)

TCP socket options (setsockopt at IPPROTO\_TCP).

small writes are always sent at once, so TCP\_NODELAY is always on. the
keepalive options are accepted and not used.
